Class BaseServlet

java.lang.Object
servlets.BaseServlet
All Implemented Interfaces:
Servlet
Direct Known Subclasses:
ClearServlet, ConfLoader, GraphDisplayer, ResetServlet, StaticResourceServlet, TopicDisplayer
public abstract class BaseServlet extends Object implements Servlet
Shared HTTP response helpers to generate common HTTPResponse DTOs.
